status: Private component source frozen; root integration and full native checkpoint verification are pending.

signals: approvalDecided(QString conversationId,QString messageId,QString partId,QString toolCallId,bool allowed)
api.input: AgentEngine::displayMessages() or static displayHistory(rawHistory), per native_core's approved presentation schema. No provider/native replay parsing in the view.
api.approvalBoundary: The view captures conversation epoch and full message/part/tool identity, checks the current rendered approval state, disables both buttons before emitting and rejects retired controls. Host MUST validate those identities and approval-requested state against a fresh Engine projection before approveTool; coalesced rendering can lag Engine state.
api.linkBoundary: Only http, https, path, tab and color links emit. No automatic navigation. Root must dispatch internal schemes through its scoped handlers. Attachment chips have no pretend open action.
api.fonts: Host supplies Geist14px body at100% and scales it once. Card headers and CodeEditor use12px baseline derived from body scale; code uses existing Roboto Mono.
api.inspection: toPlainText provides deterministic content inspection including hidden disclosure bodies, source Markdown/code and attachment names. It is not a serialization format or a clipboard action.

cmake.application: The root UI_SOURCES glob includes the four new src/ui files; existing ade_editor supplies CodeEditor. Do not compile CodeEditor.cpp twice in the production application.
cmake.note: The test sets QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen before QApplication. Root owns migrating the three older QTextBrowser lookups to ConversationView.

implemented: Stable projected message/part widgets; unchanged documents are retained rather than rebuilding a whole transcript.
Ordered text/reasoning/tool content and provisional-to-retained widget identity.
Reasoning starts visible even with empty initial text; measured duration labels; manual expansion/collapse retained per chat/part.
Consecutive exploration groups, compact successful/active/error read labels with mount-prefix stripping and attachment filename lookup.
Read→READY contract: previous read remains a non-collapsible 'Read probe.txt' row with drawn eye icon, no disclosure arrow and no generic result body.
Explicit generic tool preparation/running/approval/success/error/denied/canceled labels; inline call-bound approval controls.
Native Markdown segments and stable unfinished fenced-code cards; exact original code copying, including Unicode/NBSP/tabs, only after that text part settles.
Native code syntax via existing CodeEditor; light/dark code surfaces, readable dark gutter/links, header elision and tooltips.
Right-aligned user bubble and wrapped attachment filename chips.
100px outer follow policy, immediate wheel-up disable, scroll-end near-bottom enable, anchor restoration and jump-to-bottom; separate compact-card20px following.
Per-chat disclosure and scroll restoration; frame generation guards and deletion-safe scrollbar callbacks.
Raw HTML disabled. Custom document denies resource loading and global provider fallback; replacement image-object handler paints alt-text placeholders without Qt's direct file fallback.

verification.result: 33 passed,0 failed,2.339 seconds, including init/cleanup and six tool-state data rows.

beforeEvidence.finding: Reasoning failed to collapse after later text; dynamic code palette stayed light. Both fixed and regressed.
Actual access violation0xc0000005 when valueChanged observer deleted the view during a deferred scroll callback. QPointer and owner/epoch guards now pass deletion and chat-switch cases.

An actual existing temporary PNG was loaded despite QTextBrowser-level denial. A document override alone was also insufficient because the image handler separately reads a filename. Final fixture uses a default-document positive control and proves the transcript denies the same file.

verification.peerReview: license_review identified the scrollbar callback reentrancy boundary; reproduced and fixed. Parent paired live session identified compact read rendering; reproduced as a component fixture and implemented.
verification.noClaim: Component tests do not establish full Stagewise parity, whole-app integration correctness, universal resource safety or zero defects.

visuals.observed: User bubble/chip, collapsed exploration, Markdown/code, readable error header and inline approval.
Readable code gutter, code strings/keywords and link foreground on dark surface.
Wrapped prose and user bubble, header elision, approval controls fit. Code retains horizontal scrolling.
Expanded exploration/thinking with body and compact active read filename row.

resourceEvidence.finding: Document resources can invoke fallback providers; default loading can read local files after a parent returns no resource.
The built-in image object handler can separately fall back to reading its filename after an empty resource. The native component replaces this handler.

deliberateDifferences: Manual collapse remains respected for a part's lifetime; this is a small usability correction to upstream hook dependency transitions, not a claim of identical hook bugs.
Resource images are non-loading alt-text placeholders pending an explicit trusted attachment resolver.
Basic tools other than read use generic native cards; the engine metadata is preserved for later dedicated renderers.
remainingGaps: QScrollArea is not virtualized;160 unchanged documents were tested, but large-history memory/latency limits and full upstream virtualization parity remain open.

Qt Markdown is not Streamdown. Full math/Mermaid, all tables/controls, partial path/color/tab preprocessing, image open/download, rich attachment mentions and inline-code font/token parity require more work.
Native syntax highlighting uses existing CodeEditor, not Shiki's full language coverage or worker debounce strategy.
Detailed tool-specific cards, read skill/log/memory aliases, exploration statistics wording, shell-session cancel UI, Smart allow, custom diffs and turn-file summaries are incomplete.
User-message editing, checkpoint restore, structured runtime error retry/provider actions and their associated operation safeguards are not implemented in this component.
Pulse/shimmer animation and exact between-step/loading presentation remain gaps; active and stalled states currently use text labels.
Internal link dispatch and actual trusted image resolution are host work; no fake action is exposed.
Shared Engine/view integration, live streamed provider comparisons, and full application light/dark/zoom renders remain root validation tasks.
